blocks.content: The Authority shall consist of a Chairperson, not more than five whole-time members, and not more than four part-time members, all appointed by the Central Government.

items: The total maximum strength of the IRDAI body is 10 members (1 Chairperson + 5 Whole-Time + 4 Part-Time).
Notice the age limit difference: Chairman upper age limit is 65 years, whereas Whole-Time Member limit is 62 years.
All members are appointed by the Central Government, not by the RBI or Finance Commission.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI is a statutory body constituted under Section 4 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999.
The Authority consists of a 10-member team: 1 Chairman, up to 5 Whole-Time Members, and up to 4 Part-Time Members.
All members of the IRDAI composition are appointed directly by the Government of India.
The Chairman holds office for a term of 5 years or until reaching the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
Whole-time members hold office for a 5-year term or until reaching the age of 62 years.
